content.title: Why Nano Dimension Stock Was Sinking This Week
content.summary: 3D printing company Nano Dimension (NASDAQ: NNDM) probably can't wait for the weekend to come.  As a result, the shares were trading down nearly 22% week to date as of early afternoon Friday, according to data compiled by S&P Global Market Intelligence.  A Delaware Court of Chancery judge ruled that Nano Dimension was obligated to move forward with its deal to acquire a peer company, Desktop Metal (NYSE: DM).

content.title: 3 Industrials Stocks Skating on Thin Ice
content.summary: Even if they go mostly unnoticed, industrial businesses are the backbone of our country. Still, their generally high capital requirements expose them to the ups and downs of economic cycles, and the market seems to be baking in a prolonged downturn as the industry has shed 6% over the past six months. This drawdown was disappointing since the S&P 500 stood firm.
